source_caption:
🎬 A Simple Twist of Fate (1994)

A Simple Twist of Fate follows Michael McCann, a lonely and heartbroken man who withdraws from the world after discovering that his wife has betrayed him. Living a quiet and isolated life in a small Georgia town, Michael spends his days avoiding relationships and finding comfort in his growing collection of gold coins. However, everything changes when a young orphaned girl unexpectedly enters his home, giving him a new sense of purpose and happiness. As Michael raises the little girl as his own daughter, their bond grows into a beautiful relationship built on unconditional love, trust, and family. Years later, their peaceful life is threatened when someone from the child’s past attempts to claim her. Starring Steve Martin, Gabriel Byrne, Laura Linney, and Catherine O’Hara, the film delivers heartfelt performances, touching moments, and an emotional story about fatherhood, forgiveness, second chances, and the extraordinary ways love can transform a person’s life.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Family • Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 6.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 46m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Gillies MacKinnon

✍️ Writer: Steve Martin

📚 Inspired By: The classic novel Silas Marner by George Eliot.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: A Simple Twist of Fate is a 1994 American comedy-drama film directed by Gillies MacKinnon. The screenplay by Steve Martin is loosely based on the 1861 novel Silas Marner by George Eliot. Martin stars, along with Gabriel Byrne, Catherine O'Hara and Stephen Baldwin.
